note: No Markup has no field type, widget, settings form (configure=null), permission, Drush or plugin manager. Its entire persistent state is a per-formatter third-party setting on a field component inside an entity_view_display config entity: core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.nomarkup.{enabled,separator,referenced_entity}. enabled swaps the field to the bare field--nomarkup.html.twig template; separator (default '|') joins multi-value output; referenced_entity only applies to entity_reference_entity_view formatters. It also provides a Views style plugin id 'nomarkup'. Medium cases read back which field has nomarkup enabled and its configured separator; hard cases enable nomarkup on a field and set a custom separator, verified against the live view display. All fields namespaced field_nm_*.

evals.prompt: I enabled the Drupal 'No Markup' module but there is no admin settings page. How do I make a specific field render without its wrapper markup, and where is that choice stored?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route (configure=null). On the entity's Manage display page, open the field's formatter settings (cog) and tick 'Remove field markup'. It is stored as a third-party setting on that field's component: core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.nomarkup.enabled: true.

evals.prompt: When No Markup renders a multi-value field without markup, how are the multiple values separated, and what is the default separator?
evals.expected_output: A configurable 'separator' third-party setting joins the values; the default is '|' (NoMarkupInterface::DEFAULT_SEPARATOR). It is only used for multi-value fields.

evals.prompt: Besides stripping field markup, what Views feature does the No Markup module provide, and what is its plugin id?
evals.expected_output: It provides a Views style plugin with id 'nomarkup' (label 'No markup', theme views_view_nomarkup) that renders a view's rows with no additional wrapping markup.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field configured with No Markup so it renders without wrapper markup. Inspect the live default view display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_nm_known: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component has third_party_settings.nomarkup.enabled: true.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article field field_nm_multi renders without markup via No Markup and is multi-value. Inspect the live view-display configuration and state the multi-value separator No Markup will use for it.
evals.expected_output: The separator is ';' - in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_nm_multi component has third_party_settings.nomarkup.separator: ';'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field field_nm_task shown on the default display. Using the No Markup module, configure the default view display so that this field renders without its wrapper markup. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_nm_task component carries third_party_settings.nomarkup.enabled: true (set the component's third_party_settings and save, or tick 'Remove field markup' on the field in Manage display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a multi-value field field_nm_sep on the default display. Using No Markup, make this field render without wrapper markup AND join its multiple values with the separator ' / ' (space slash space). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_nm_sep component carries third_party_settings.nomarkup.enabled: true and third_party_settings.nomarkup.separator: ' / '.
